stage: Before inspecting or accepting fourth-order32 or48 response output
hypothesis: If leading velocity finite-difference error drives the32/48 spread, fourth-order velocity should reduce that spread at all three temperatures.
comparison: Compare abs(fourth48/fourth32-1) against abs(second48/second32-1) separately at2/4/8K. Passing means reduced observed two-grid sensitivity only; it does not bound continuum error.
conditional_model: S_h=S_limit+c*h^2. Extrapolated limits are a diagnostic prediction under that model, not fit parameters, acceptance tolerances or physical estimates. DOS integration also changes, so this model may fail.
